stem.en: At a given instant, in which direction does the velocity of an object in uniform circular motion point?
stem.et: Millises suunas osutab ühtlases ringliikumises oleva keha kiirus antud hetkel?

label.en: Tangent to the circle at that point, perpendicular to the radius
label.et: Ringjoone puutujaks selles punktis, risti raadiusega

label.en: Directly toward the centre of the circle
Directly away from the centre of the circle
It has no fixed direction, since the motion is circular
label.et: Sellel ei ole kindlat suunda, sest liikumine on ringikujuline
